verdict.rationale: Edge evaluation is a fair question for a feature-flag platform, but the evidence pack never mentions CDN workers, edge runtimes, or a relay/proxy layer. Local evaluation in server SDKs and on-device evaluation in client SDKs are different SDK architectures and do not show edge delivery close to users.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can evaluate flags at the edge (CDN workers or an edge/relay layer) close to users
